text:
Maya Patel: Quick thread — we need final speaker one-pagers + 2 gated content pieces for the webinar. Goal: landing page + two top-of-funnel gated assets (cheat sheet + benchmark snapshot). Who can take the one-pagers?

Oliver Chen: I can do the tech one-pager (runtime/latency/cost bullets). Will need the final numbers from infra. ETA EOD Tue.

Maya Patel: Awesome. Oliver — please include a 2-line TL;DR, 3 bullets with numbers, and 1 visual ask for design (comparison bar).

Jamie Rodriguez: I’ll draft the customer story one-pager and a short quote from the customer. Can you @Amit get the quote cleared?

Amit Gupta: On it. I’ll ping Legal and the customer today and try to get the quote by Monday.

Sara Kim: I can own the gated cheat sheet ("Practical Inference Checklist") and a 1-page benchmark snapshot (latency vs cost tradeoffs). Need the render-ready numbers from Oliver.

Oliver Chen: copying the quick draft numbers here — still finalizing:
```
Average p99 latency (gen-16k): 180ms
Tokens/sec (batched): 2,400
Token cost equiv (hosted): $0.0009/token
Cache hit benefit: ~35% cost reduction on steady-state prompts
```
Use as ballpark until I drop final sheet.

Maya Patel: Nice. For gated assets promo: we’re splitting promo into three buckets — (1) organic social + LinkedIn posts, (2) targeted paid audience (dev infra + ML eng), (3) partner co-promo. Need CTAs and lead routing for each.

Jamie Rodriguez: Proposed CTAs: (organic) "Get the cheat sheet"; (paid) "See the benchmark snapshot" with gated access; (partners) "Request a private briefing".

Amit Gupta: For lead routing → please add these fields on the form: name, email, company, role, intent (checkbox: evaluate/POC/curious), webinar_source (utm_source), partner (if referred). Tag leads as webinar_2026_promopool in CRM.

Sara Kim: Can we standardize UTMs? I’ll put a template in drive.

Maya Patel: Yes — use this UTM pattern (copy for all promo links):
```
?utm_source={{channel}}&utm_medium={{paid|organic|partner}}&utm_campaign=webinar_infer_2026&utm_content={{asset}}
```
Also require a hidden field on the form: campaign_bucket = {{paid|organic|partner}} so ops can route.

Oliver Chen: Design ask: 1 hero image for landing, 2 one-pager cover templates, 1 benchmark chart export (PNG + SVG). Sara/Jamie — where should I drop chart CSV?

Sara Kim: Drop CSV in marketing > webinar-assets > charts. I’ll create figma frames.

Jamie Rodriguez: Rehearsal logistics — we need a dry run with slides + run-of-show. Can we book 45m on Thu?

Maya Patel: Thu sounds good. Ops: slide limit 8, demo queue 10 minutes, backup demo recording ready. We’ll do 2 run-throughs: content + technical check.

Amit Gupta: Who will own attendee gating and follow-up email content? I can take follow-up nurture (email 0, email 3, email 10). Need eventbrite/RSVP export access.

Maya Patel: Amit owns nurture. @Jamie please draft email 0 copy (short with asset links) and share by Tue noon.

ops-bot: Reminder: rehearsal booked Thu 11:00–11:45 PST (calendar invite sent to participants).

Sara Kim: Quick note on messaging — callout the "unified serving" angle in hero headline (helps platform vs model positioning). Keep the lead magnet headline: "Cost & Latency Playbook for Serving LLMs."

Oliver Chen: Agreed — tech headline + 3 bullets under hero (throughput, latency, cost).

Jamie Rodriguez: I'll also draft 2 short LinkedIn copy variants (developer-focused and product-focused) and drop in the drive for review.

Maya Patel: Sweet. Action list summary: Oliver: tech one-pager + final numbers (EOD Tue). Jamie: customer one-pager + email0 + LinkedIn copy (Tue noon). Sara: gated assets + figma frames + utm file (Tue). Amit: quote clearance + nurture flows + CRM tags (Mon/Tue). Design: assets folder + chart exports. Rehearsal Thu 11. Ops-bot confirmed.

Oliver Chen: Got it.

Jamie Rodriguez: On it.

Sara Kim: Will upload everything to marketing/webinar-assets by Tue. :rocket:

Amit Gupta: I’ll chase legal & customer today.

Maya Patel: Thanks team — tagging this as our prep sprint. If anything blocks, ping here asap. :thumbsup:
